_comment: This project's own config. It is the SINGLE-REPO case — one repo owning the workspace root, no
siblings, nothing to pin — which is precisely the case DojoStack can never exercise and the one
that decides whether 'reusable' is real rather than aspirational (founding design §8).
Phase 3 (self-hosting: own graph, own gate) builds on this; declaring the topology is just the
tool saying what it is, and the entrypoints refuse to guess without it.
